lines.zh: 我在深暗之域的暗处飞。
lines.en: I fly through the dark of the Deep Dark.

lines.zh: 我的翅上沾着幽匿的蓝。
lines.en: My wings are dusted with sculk blue.

lines.zh: 我穿过幽匿块之间的空隙。
lines.en: I slip through the gaps between the sculk blocks.
I go around a sculk block.
My wingbeats make almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁的裂缝里出来。
lines.en: I come out of a crack in the wall.
I fly so low I graze the floor.

lines.zh: 我一动，幽匿的脉络亮了一下。
lines.en: I move and the sculk veins pulse.

lines.zh: 我绕着那根柱子飞了一圈。
lines.en: I circle that pillar once.

lines.zh: 我从探查器的范围外面过。
lines.en: I pass outside the sensor's range.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在幽匿块上。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the sculk.
I rise slowly into midair.
I look down at the veins.

lines.zh: 我贴着一片幽匿脉络飞。
lines.en: I fly along a patch of veins.

lines.zh: 我落到一块骨头上，又起来。
lines.en: I settle on a bone, then rise.

lines.zh: 我绕开那团发亮的东西。
lines.en: I steer around that glowing mass.
I hang from a rib bone.
The sculk glow falls over me.

lines.zh: 这里安静得听得见自己。
lines.en: It is so quiet I can hear myself.

lines.zh: 我挂在骨架上，听脉络亮起来。
lines.en: I hang from the skeleton and listen for the veins to light.
The veins are moving slowly.
I have caught nothing.

lines.zh: 我挂着头朝下，眼睛发亮。
lines.en: Hanging head down, my eyes shine.
There is no wind in this dark.
My cry is very short.

lines.zh: 我在等有人踩到那些块。
lines.en: I wait for someone to step on those blocks.
Hanging head down suits me.
You stepped on sculk.
The veins have heard you.

lines.zh: 你不该来这么深的地方。
lines.en: You should not come this deep.
I hang above and watch you.
That torch is far too bright.
Your steps have woken this place.
The blue on my wings belongs to it.
Do not make a single sound.
I have lived here a long time.
You smell of freshly dug earth.
I am struck and skew.

lines.zh: 我撞在幽匿块上，翼膜皱了。
lines.en: I hit a sculk block and my wing membrane crumples.
I fly behind the bones.
It hurts, and there is no echo here.
I curl up and try not to move.
Blue blood seeps out.
That made me drop.
I caught the bone again.

lines.zh: 蓝血滴在骨架上，被听见了。
lines.en: Blue blood drips on the skeleton and is heard.
You will be heard too.
I want that dim glow.
I shift a little that way.

lines.zh: 那块幽匿糖果的腥甜，我闻到了。
lines.en: I catch the bloody sweetness of that sculk candy.
It smells sweet, and a little of blood.
Let go first.
I will take it back and hang it.
The sculk likes this.

lines.zh: 那点动静，幽匿早就听见了。
lines.en: The sculk already heard that little noise.
You bumped the bone I hang from.
I dart into the dark.

lines.zh: 这一碰让幽匿亮了一下。
lines.en: The touch made the sculk pulse.
My wing bones cannot hurt you.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，谁也没出声。
lines.en: We touched and neither made a sound.
I circle back to where I was.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到了我的翅膀。
lines.en: Your torch caught my wing.
Be quiet; it will bring more.
I retreat into the veins.
Pairing is not the way here.

lines.zh: 我是从幽匿里长出来的。
lines.en: I grew out of the sculk.
I am the only one in this dark.
You asked too loudly.
I shrink into my wings.
My blood is blue, and not warm.
That is very far from me.
Say no more; be quiet.
I fly a little deeper.
That subject has no echo.
I take it and fly a little higher.
It gives off a faint light.
I fly to a bone and gnaw slowly.
This bone is too hard.
I wedge it between the bones.
It fell into the sculk.
Carrying it makes my flight uneven.
I taste it; a little earthy.
Good; hidden.

lines.zh: 你脚下的脉络亮，我看见了。
lines.en: The veins under your feet glow; I see you.
The sculk veins light that way.
You have lit up the veins.
The dark here does not help you.
I let go of the bone.
I begin flying toward you.

lines.zh: 这深暗里只有我们两个。
lines.en: Only the two of us are in this dark.
The block you stepped on is lit.
I fly just over your head.
You go deeper, where it is darker.
The veins keep glowing.
The sculk veins count for me.
You stop to listen; so do I.
I come around the other side.
The dark swallows my wingbeats.
You look back and see only bones.
I land on the stone behind you.
Two more steps and you are there.
I dive at your neck and bite.
Light, but very sharp.
I land back on the bone.

lines.zh: 我从暗处窜出，撞你的下巴。
lines.en: I dart out of the dark and clip your jaw.
You step back into the wall.
I circle your head.
That swing caught nothing.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下来，牙磕在你的护腕上。
lines.en: I dive and my teeth click on your bracer.
You go; I hang back up.
I emerge from a sculk block.
My wings still carry blue.
This is the Deep Dark.

lines.zh: 一群一两只，我们不爱成群。
lines.en: One or two of us; we do not gather.
The veins know me.
I hang from a bone and wait.
The light is very weak here.

lines.zh: 我从幽匿脉络的缝里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out through a gap in the sculk veins.
There is a faint sound far off.
Good; let us be quiet.

lines.zh: 火光一照，我翅膀都缩了。
lines.en: The firelight makes my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我掉在幽匿上，闷响一声。
lines.en: I land on the sculk with a dull thud.
Water soaks through and my wings are drenched.

lines.zh: 爆响在深暗里传得很远。
lines.en: The blast carries far in the Deep Dark.

lines.zh: 箭穿过黑暗，扎进我的翅膀。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the dark and hits my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量让幽匿全部亮了。
lines.en: That force lights every sculk vein.

lines.zh: 这里没有虫子，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No insects here; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光把整片深暗照白了。
lines.en: The flash turns the whole dark white.
I fall into the void, wings barely sounding.
